spans.s: सौध (I) a. (f. धी) 1. Relating to nectar; 2. having plaster, plastered.
सौध (II) n. A white-washed mansion, ततस्तदालोकनतत्पराणां सौधेषु चामीकरजालवत्सु R.vii.5, Megh.i.27; 3. a great house, a palace; 4. silver.
सौध (I) a. (f. धी) 1. Relating to nectar; 2. having plaster, plastered.
सौध-कार m. the builder of a house.
